child_list.content: The Mice Hold a Meeting
child_list.name: 题目

elements.content: Once, all the mice had a big problem. A cat was catching them. They needed a plan. So, they held a meeting. One little mouse said, “Let’s put a bell on the cat. Then we can hear her coming.” All the mice liked the idea. But then, an old mouse asked, “Who will put the bell on the cat?” All the mice looked around. No one wanted to do it. They realized it was a good idea, but it was very hard to do. In the end, they had to find another way to stay safe.

child_list.content: Hello, hello, hello
child_list.name: 题目

elements.content:
Hello, hello, hello. Hi, hi, hi.

Good morning to you, good morning to you.

It’s a beautiful day, let’s go out and play.

Good afternoon to you, good afternoon to you.

It’s a nice day, let’s whistle a tune.

Good evening to you, good evening to you.

It’s wonderful night, let’s dance in the moonlight

child_list.content: 老鼠开会
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content: 有一次，所有的老鼠都遇到了一个大问题。有一只猫在抓他们。他们需要一个计划。于是，他们开了个会。一只小老鼠说：“我们给猫戴上铃铛吧。这样我们就能听到她来了。”所有的老鼠都喜欢这个主意。这时，一只年长的老鼠问：“谁来给猫戴铃铛？”所有的老鼠都面面相觑。没人愿意做这件事。他们意识到这是个好主意，但是很难做到。最后，他们不得不另想方法来保证自身的安全。

child_list.content: 你好，你好，你好
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
你好，你好，你好。嗨，嗨，嗨。

早上好，早上好。

美好的一天，我们出去玩吧。

下午好，下午好。

美好的一天，让我们吹口哨吧。

晚上好，晚上好。

美好的夜晚，让我们在月光下跳舞吧。
